events.description: Everyone knows what is typically Belgian. Or do they? Located in the heart of Brussels, next to the Royal Palace, the BELvue museum let you discover today’s Belgium and its history through seven themes: democracy, prosperity, solidarity, pluralism, migration, language and Europe. Have a look at the gallery too: there are more than 200 Belgian objects to view, each one forming a tangible memory of Belgium. Do you want to discover the museum as a family? Yes, you can! There are several play tours for children aged 3 to 12 (€1/child). Simply ask at the reception desk.

events.description: Join us for an unforgettable journey through the heart of Brussels, starting at the iconic Grand Place, once the city’s political and economic center. Victor Hugo himself called it "the most beautiful square in the world"! Its breathtaking architecture and rich history will leave you in awe. We’ll then explore the surrounding streets, uncovering vibrant street art, the legendary Manneken Pis, and the elegant Galleries of St. Hubert, the world’s first shopping arcade. Next, we’ll visit the charming Sablon district, famous for its exquisite art galleries and sophisticated atmosphere. Our journey concludes in the prestigious Royal Court district, where you’ll enjoy a stunning panoramic view of the city from the Mont des Arts. Experience the magic of Brussels with expert guides who bring the city’s history and culture to life!

events.description: Immerse yourself in the heart of the Brussels City Hall and let yourself be transported back through the centuries thanks to an interactive experience. As soon as you arrive on the magnificent Grand-Place, you'll be captivated by the imposing silhouette of this emblematic building, a veritable jewel of flamboyant Gothic architecture. In 23 different steps, around the bend of a monumental staircase, a precious cabinet or a room well known to the people of Brussels, this tour will take you from one era to another, retracing nearly six centuries of history! You can explore the City Hall at your own pace with the help of your videoguide. For the more adventurous, take a guided tour on the weekends and climb up to the tower, which offers a 360-degree view of the city, a breathtaking experience that will allow you to admire the Brussels skyline. Whether you're a history buff, an art lover or a family in search of adventure, a visit to Brussels City Hall will enchant and inspire you.

ai.en: Explore the interiors of the Palais Stoclet through a digital reconstruction based on archival sources. This exhibition offers an immersive experience of the palace as it was between 1911 and 1918.
ai.fr: Explorez les intérieurs du Palais Stoclet grâce à une reconstruction numérique basée sur des sources d'archives. Cette exposition offre une expérience immersive du palais tel qu'il était entre 1911 et 1918.
ai.nl: Verken de interieurs van het Stocletpaleis via een digitale reconstructie gebaseerd op archiefbronnen. Deze tentoonstelling biedt een meeslepende ervaring van het paleis zoals het was tussen 1911 en 1918.

events.description: Result of a collaboration between urban.brussels, the ULB - Architecture Faculty La Cambre Horta and the Art & History Museum, initiated to mark the Brussels Art Nouveau Year 2023, this exhibition and the digital reconstruction presented in the form of a film are designed to enable visitors to explore the interiors of the Palais Stoclet, which has been on the very select list of Brussels buildings included on UNESCO's World Heritage List since 2009, and yet is still little known to the general public. The virtual reconstruction of this palace (which reproduces the state of the palace between 1911 and 1918 and does not represent the existing situation) is based on precise archival sources and a detailed architectural analysis of its spaces, a task that kept the ULB team of experts busy for almost two years. This scientific study of the Stoclet Palace is part of a close collaboration between experts from the Brussels-Capital Region (Urban.brussels) and ULB (alICe Laboratory). Its realism reinforces the impression that visitors are being immersed in the building's original state, between 1911 and 1918: the public is discovering the palace exactly as the couple Suzanne Stevens and Adolphe Stoclet dreamed it would be. Through this research, the Brussels Region hopes not only to make this knowledge accessible to as many people as possible, but also to build up a scientific information base on the spatial nature of the building and its remarkable decorations. Behind this digital…

ai.en: The Sewer Museum exhibition 'After rain comes...' explores the impact of rain on Brussels' sewer system and the environment. Discover innovative solutions and consider rain as a valuable resource.

ai.nl: De tentoonstelling 'Na de regen komt...' in het Riolenmuseum onderzoekt de impact van regen op het Brusselse rioleringssysteem en het milieu. Ontdek innovatieve oplossingen en beschouw regen als een waardevolle bron.

events.description: Rain is an everyday topic that often comes up. The natural phenomenon continues to occupy our minds, from simple things like our weekend plans to serious concerns like climate change, heatwaves and floods. But have you ever thought about what exactly happens after a rainstorm? What does rain do to our sewer system in Brussels and what effect does it have on the environment? And wouldn’t we be better off considering rain as a valuable resource rather than something to be disposed of as quickly as possible? All these questions and many more are addressed in the exhibition, through concrete examples and current, innovative solutions.

More than 16 hours to dicover the great moments of Jacques Brel's life !

events.description: Tous les jours nous marchons sur des pavés dorés incrustés sur le sol des trottoirs bruxellois. Leurs faces supérieures, recouvertes d'une plaque en laiton, honorent la mémoire d'une victime du nazisme. Placés devant son dernier domicile connu, ces pavés de mémoire sont créés à la main par l'artiste allemand Gunter Demnig. Les enfants de 5ème année primaire de l’école Peter Pan ont découvert les pavés de leur quartier ainsi que les trajectoires de vie des personnes auxquelles ils sont dédiés et ont défriché des traces qui révèlent l'Histoire de la Résistance. À l’initiative de Rébecca Fruitman, plusieurs balades sonores ont émergé à destination du public. Les voix des enfants rythment cette déambulation biographique qui lève le voile sur une sombre période de notre Histoire. Parcours Résistance 4,1 km – 90 minutes Ce sont des trajectoires de résistants qui tissent cet itinéraire jalonné de lieux clés où des réseaux se sont organisés dès 1939. Il y est question de presse clandestine, du Mouvement National Belge, du réseau Comète, du Groupe Général de sabotage, de filières d’évacuation d’alliés et de la prison de Saint-Gilles où de nombreux opposants à l’occupation ont été incarcérés dans le but d’être interrogés, torturés voire déportés. Parcours Migration 2,7 km – 60 minutes Les histoires présentées ici ont en commun d’être celles d’immigrés juifs. Au début du 20ᵉ siècle, Saint-Gilles a accueilli un nombre croissant de juifs d’Europe de l’Est fuyant pogroms et violences…

summary.en: Learn how to become a chocolate artisan and make your own Belgian chocolates. Master the tips and tricks to make delicious pralines and mendiant chocolates at a 2.5-hour workshop. Best part? You get to take home all your creations! !Must…

ai.en: Learn the art of Belgian chocolate making in a 2.5-hour workshop. Temper chocolate, mold pralines, craft mendiants, and enjoy a hot chocolate while creating your own sweet treats.
ai.fr: Apprenez l'art de la fabrication du chocolat belge dans un atelier de 2,5 heures. Tempérez le chocolat, moulez des pralines, fabriquez des mendiants et dégustez un chocolat chaud tout en créant vos propres douceurs.
ai.nl: Leer de kunst van het Belgische chocolade maken in een workshop van 2,5 uur. Temper chocolade, vorm pralines, maak mendiants en geniet van een warme chocolademelk terwijl u uw eigen zoete lekkernijen creëert.

events.description: After splitting up into teams of 2 or 3 (you always stay with whom you booked) and we will explain some theory on chocolate tempering techniques before letting you express your creativity! The workshop is divided into different parts. We will first temper the chocolate, then mold the outside of the praline shells. After that, we will work together on making some chocolate ganache - that will be used as one of our fillings -, then crafting the mendiants before filling up & closing our chocolate shells. While we wait for the chocolate to harden, we will have a chat with everyone while sipping one of the best hot chocolate ever! Our 2.5h chocolate making workshop animated in English by one of our skilled facilitator, the use of an apron (non compulsory), all the ingredients + all the necessary cookware to craft yourself 20 pralines & 10+ mendiants chocolates from scratch, a nice box take them home with you and a delicious hot chocolate!

ai.nl: Maak een panoramische rondleiding door het Stadhuis. Bezoek belangrijke zalen, geniet van een vogelvluchtperspectief op de Grote Markt vanaf het balkon en beklim de toren voor een uitzonderlijk uitzicht over Brussel.

events.description: The panoramic guided tour offers the opportunity to discover two of the main halls (the Wedding Hall and the Gothic Hall). Visitors will then be directed to the balcony of the City Hall to enjoy a bird's eye view of the Grand-Place. The visit continues with an ascent to the tower of the City Hall, reached by a spiral staircase. You are rewarded at the top by an exceptional view of Brussels.

summary.fr: Tout au long d’un parcours qui vous emmène sur les différents lieux culturels du campus UCLouvain Woluwe, des poèmes de Laurence Vielle subliment ces endroits que l’on fréquente au quotidien, sans toujours prendre le temps de s’y arrêter…

ai.en: Explore the UCLouvain Bruxelles Woluwe campus through art and walking. This project invites you to discover the campus's cultural spaces, research areas, and hidden poetry with a provided map.
ai.fr: Explorez le campus UCLouvain Bruxelles Woluwe à travers l'art et la marche. Ce projet vous invite à découvrir les espaces culturels, les lieux de recherche et la poésie cachée du campus avec une carte fournie.
ai.nl: Verken de UCLouvain Brussel Woluwe campus door middel van kunst en wandelen. Dit project nodigt u uit om de culturele ruimtes, onderzoeksgebieden en verborgen poëzie van de campus te ontdekken met een meegeleverde kaart.

events.description: Connaissez-vous vraiment le campus UCLouvain Bruxelles Woluwe ? Situé à la station de métro Alma, on le croit souvent réservé aux étudiants et aux Cliniques universitaires Saint-Luc. Et pourtant… c’est un véritable quartier à part entière, vivant, verdoyant, parsemé d’espaces culturels, d’auditoires, de lieux de recherche, d’écoles… et de poésie ! Le projet ALlons MArcher vous invite à explorer ce campus autrement, à travers la marche et la création artistique. Le parcours est accompagnée d’une carte papier, recensant les points d'intérêts culturels du campus, conçue avec finesse par le studio graphique belge Pierre Papier Studio, à demander gratuitement par mail.

summary.fr: Beaucoup plus que simple boisson, la bière a des liens historiques, culturels, sociaux avec la ville de Bruxelles, ses espaces, ses habitants. Partez à la découverte du coeur historique sous l’oeil de la bière, découvrez les noms des…
summary.nl: Bier is veel meer dan alleen een drankje, het heeft historische, culturele en sociale banden met de stad Brussel, haar ruimtes en haar inwoners. Ontdek het historische centrum door de ogen van het bier, ontdek de namen van de oudste en…

ai.en: Discover Brussels' beer heritage on a guided stroll. Learn about the city's historical and cultural ties to beer, visit old pubs, and enjoy a commented tasting session.
ai.fr: Découvrez le patrimoine brassicole de Bruxelles lors d'une promenade guidée. Apprenez les liens historiques et culturels de la ville avec la bière, visitez d'anciens estaminets et profitez d'une dégustation commentée.
ai.nl: Ontdek het biererfgoed van Brussel tijdens een begeleide wandeling. Leer over de historische en culturele banden van de stad met bier, bezoek oude cafés en geniet van een proeverij met commentaar.

events.description: “Ça sent la bière, de Londres à Berlin” sang our great Jacques Brel, and Brussels has always held its liquid gold reputation high! Much more than a simple drink, beer has historical, cultural and social links with the city of Brussels, its spaces and its people. Discover the historic heart of the city through the eyes of beer, learn the names of the oldest and most distinctive estaminets, and round off your stroll with a commented beer tasting! A perfect way to start your weekend, or your week...

ai.en: Embark on 'The Chocolate Route' to discover the history and masters of Belgian chocolate. Learn about different chocolatiers, their techniques, and enjoy a special tasting.
ai.fr: Embarquez sur 'La Route du Chocolat' pour découvrir l'histoire et les maîtres du chocolat belge. Apprenez-en davantage sur les différents chocolatiers, leurs techniques, et profitez d'une dégustation spéciale.
ai.nl: Ga op 'De Chocolade Route' om de geschiedenis en de meesters van Belgische chocolade te ontdekken. Leer meer over verschillende chocolatiers, hun technieken en geniet van een speciale proeverij.

events.description: The Belgian chocolate label is well established. But to whom do we owe it? This itinerary will introduce you to the great names of Belgian chocolate, whether they have left their mark on history or are still writing it. Discover the characteristics of each of our master chocolatiers, both in terms of their techniques and their specificities. You'll enjoy an appetizer that will make your heart skip a beat for one master chocolatier in particular!

summary.fr: Le Centre-ville nous mène vers les somptueux magasins Waucquez et des frères Wolfers. Horta est un artiste fertile cherchant toujours l’innovation et le renouvellement. Après la première guerre mondiale et son voyage en Amérique, Horta se…
summary.nl: Het stadscentrum leidt ons naar de weelderige winkels van de gebroeders Waucquez en Wolfers. Horta was een vruchtbare kunstenaar, altijd op zoek naar vernieuwing en innovatie. Na de Eerste Wereldoorlog en zijn reis naar Amerika richtte…

ai.en: Journey from Art Nouveau to Art Deco in downtown Brussels. Explore former Art Nouveau stores, now cultural centers, and discover Art Deco architecture, including works by Horta.
ai.fr: Voyagez de l'Art Nouveau à l'Art Déco au centre-ville de Bruxelles. Explorez d'anciens magasins Art Nouveau, aujourd'hui centres culturels, et découvrez l'architecture Art Déco, y compris des œuvres de Horta.
ai.nl: Reis van Art Nouveau tot Art Deco in het centrum van Brussel. Verken voormalige Art Nouveau-winkels, nu culturele centra, en ontdek Art Deco-architectuur, inclusief werken van Horta.

events.description: Downtown leads us to the sumptuous Waucquez and Wolfers brothers stores. Now respectfully the Centre Belge de la Bande Dessinée and a toy store, they are the only remaining store spaces. Horta was a fertile artist, always seeking innovation and renewal. After the First World War and his trip to America, Horta turned to a more stripped-down, geometric style known as Art Décoratif. The most representative example of the architect's period is the façade of the Bozar. And yes, it is a facade by Horta. Even more surprisingly, it was he who designed the well-known Gare-Centrale in our beloved Brussels. Available languages: FR/EN/NL/ESP/POR/ITA/DEU

summary.fr: Découvrez les merveilles du chocolat belge et apprenez à réaliser ces délicieuses gourmandises dans la plus grande chocolaterie de Bruxelles. Profitez d'un atelier (en anglais) d'une heure et demie avec les conseils d'experts chocolatiers…
summary.nl: Ontdek de wonderen van Belgische chocolade en leer hoe je deze lekkernijen maakt in de grootste chocoladewinkel van Brussel. Geniet van een workshop van anderhalf uur (in het Engels) met advies van deskundige chocolatiers en probeer zelf…

ai.en: Join a 1.5-hour chocolate workshop at The Belgian Chocolate Makers. Learn secrets from expert chocolatiers, temper chocolate, and create your own pralines, mendiants, and lollipops.
ai.fr: Participez à un atelier de chocolat d'1h30 chez The Belgian Chocolate Makers. Apprenez les secrets de chocolatiers experts, tempérez le chocolat et créez vos propres pralines, mendiants et sucettes.
ai.nl: Neem deel aan een chocoladeworkshop van 1,5 uur bij The Belgian Chocolate Makers. Leer geheimen van deskundige chocolatiers, temper chocolade en maak uw eigen pralines, mendiants en lollipops.

events.description: Discover the wonders of Belgian chocolate and learn how to make these tasty treats at the biggest chocolate store in Brussels. Enjoy an hour-and-a-half workshop (in English) with the guidance of expert chocolatiers and have a go at making amazing handmade chocolates yourself. We are the only certified handcraft chocolate maker in Brussels city. The experience begins with a warm welcome from your guides and a delicious hot chocolate or frozen mucilage depending the weather. While you drink, listen to a short but fascinating introduction into the world of Belgian chocolate and learn an array of chocolate making secrets. After the intro, the real fun begins with a demonstration of chocolate tempering on a marble table. It’s then time to have a go yourself and make your own chocolate treats with the help of expert chocolatiers. Spend the hour making your very own personalized and tasty mendiants, truffles, lollipops and more. You’ll also taste the ruby chocolate, a newly discovered cocoa bean that is 100% natural but which creates incredibly pink chocolate treats! At the end of the experience, package up your chocolates and take them home with you to share with friends, or enjoy alone! Of course you will not become a true chocolate maker in only one hour but I will share with you a little bit of the magic of my job! The workshop takes place every day of the week (Monday to Sunday) at 11am, 2pm and 5pm.

ai.en: Visit Mini-Europe for an open-air journey through the continent's wonders. See 350 detailed miniatures of European landmarks, enjoy live animations, and learn about EU countries.
ai.fr: Visitez Mini-Europe pour un voyage en plein air à travers les merveilles du continent. Admirez 350 miniatures détaillées de monuments européens, profitez d'animations en direct et découvrez les pays de l'UE.
ai.nl: Bezoek Mini-Europe voor een openluchtreis door de wonderen van het continent. Bekijk 350 gedetailleerde miniatuurversies van Europese bezienswaardigheden, geniet van live animaties en leer over EU-landen.

events.description: Mini-Europe is a park featuring all the wonders of Europe, in miniature. Bonsai trees, flowery groves and dwarf trees embellish the 350 monuments which have been reproduced at scale 1/25. Thousands of lifelike figurines and live action animations! A two-hour walk, that is both entertaining and educational, to learn about 27 member states of the European Union and the historical, architectural and cultural wealth of Europe. There are multiple options to buy combined tickets at the entrance of Mini-Europe for other attractions in Brussels (Planetarium, Atomium, Tootbus). Displayed price is online for tickets bought 48 hours before visit. https://www.minieurope.com/en/individual-rates/ Please note that the park closes an hour after the closing time of the entrance desk.

summary.en: Visits of the City Hall of Brussels are possible with a video guide. These visits are available as an itinerary for adults or families, in French, Dutch, English, German, Italian and Spanish.
summary.fr: Des visites avec visioguide sont proposées à l'Hôtel de Ville de Bruxelles dans un parcours adulte ou un parcours famille, en français, néerlandais, allemand, anglais, italien et espagnol.
summary.nl: Bezoeken met een videogids zijn mogelijk in het Stadhuis van Brussel. Deze bezoeken zijn beschikbaar als route voor volwassenen of gezinnen, in het Frans, Nederlands, Duits, Engels, Italiaans en Spaans.

ai.en: Explore the City Hall of Brussels through an interactive experience spanning nearly 6 centuries of history. Discover its Gothic architecture at your own pace or join a weekend guided tour for panoramic city views.
ai.fr: Explorez l'Hôtel de Ville de Bruxelles à travers une expérience interactive retraçant près de 6 siècles d'histoire. Découvrez son architecture gothique à votre rythme ou rejoignez une visite guidée le week-end pour des vues panoramiques de la ville.
ai.nl: Ontdek het Stadhuis van Brussel via een interactieve ervaring die bijna 6 eeuwen geschiedenis omvat. Verken de gotische architectuur in uw eigen tempo of neem deel aan een rondleiding in het weekend voor een panoramisch uitzicht over de stad.

events.description: Immerse yourself in the heart of the City Hall of Brussels and let yourself be transported back through the centuries thanks to an interactive experience. As soon as you arrive on the Grand-Place, you'll be captivated by the imposing silhouette of this emblematic building, a jewel of Gothic architecture. In 23 different steps, around the bend of a monumental staircase, a precious cabinet or a room well known to the people of Brussels, this tour will take you from one era to another, retracing nearly 6 centuries of history. You can explore the City Hall at your own pace with the help of your videoguide. For the more adventurous, take a guided tour on the weekends and climb up to the tower, which offers a 360-degree view of the city. This breathtaking experience allows you to admire the skyline of Brussels. Whether you're a history buff, an art lover or a family in search of adventure, a visit to the City Hall of Brussels will enchant and inspire you.

title.fr: Visite du Belgian Beer World Experience

summary.en: Discover the place dedicated to beer, where each experience is a story, a surprise and a pleasure !
summary.fr: Découvrez le lieu dédié à la bière où chaque expérience est une histoire, une surprise et un plaisir !
summary.nl: Ontdek een plek gewijd aan bier, waar elke ervaring een verhaal, een verrassing en een plezier is !

ai.en: Discover Belgium's UNESCO-listed beer heritage at Belgian Beer World, located in the historic Brussels Stock Exchange. Explore the brewing process and enjoy a tasting session.
ai.fr: Découvrez le patrimoine brassicole belge, classé au patrimoine mondial de l'UNESCO, au Belgian Beer World, situé dans la magnifique Bourse de Bruxelles. Explorez le processus de brassage et profitez d'une séance de dégustation.
ai.nl: Ontdek het Belgische biererfgoed, erkend door UNESCO, in Belgian Beer World in de historische Brusselse Beurs. Verken het brouwproces en geniet van een proeverij.

events.description: Welcome to Belgian Beer World, the museum of Beer in residence at the magnificent Brussels Stock Exchange building. Belgium has a great beer brewing tradition that, thankfully for us, has been handed down through generations. It even has UNESCO world heritage status! At Belgian Beer World, around hundred Belgian breweries, from the very smallest to the biggest, welcome you and encourage you to explore our beers and our Belgitude. The history of beer, the extraordinary variety, the brewing process, tales from brewing families, and much much more… all in an interactive environment. And saving the best till last: a tasting session. Cheers!

summary.fr: Prépare-toi à plonger dans un univers futuriste étincelant en entrant dans la ville néon de Supercube ! Fonce sur nos circuits pleins de surprises et profite de nos bonus délirants — comme les pistolets ou les bombes — pour laisser tes…
summary.nl: Maak je klaar voor een duik in een glinsterend futuristisch universum en betreed de neonstad Supercube! Race over onze circuits vol verrassingen en profiteer van onze waanzinnige power-ups – zoals laserpistolen en spuitbussen – om je…

ai.en: Experience an immersive karting adventure where reality meets video games at Supercube. Race on surprising tracks with power-ups and compete against other players.
ai.fr: Vivez une aventure de karting immersive où la réalité rencontre les jeux vidéo chez Supercube. Courez sur des pistes surprenantes avec des bonus et affrontez d'autres joueurs.
ai.nl: Beleef een meeslepend kartavontuur waar realiteit en videogames samenkomen bij Supercube. Race op verrassende circuits met power-ups en neem het op tegen andere spelers.

events.description: Welcome to Supercube, where reality and video games collide in a karting experience that will blow your mind. With our immersive digital playground, you'll feel like you're stepping into a video game as you strap into your kart, put on your headset, and get ready to battle other players on surprising tracks filled with crazy power-ups. Leave your opponents in the dust and cross the finish line first! Get your game on and join us for a karting experience unlike any other! DISCOUNT CODE : VISIT15

summary.fr: Le musée présente le résultat d’un partenariat inédit et surprenant : un dialogue entre l’art contemporain et la recherche scientifique. Des artistes ont travaillé en étroite interaction avec des chercheurs, et se sont inspirés des…
summary.nl: Het museum stelt vanaf woensdag 18 maart het resultaat van een verrassende samenwerking voor: een dialoog tussen hedendaagse kunst en wetenschappelijk onderzoek. Kunstenaars werkten nauw samen met onderzoekers en inspireerden zich op de…

events.description: Les Heures Bleues et Future Fossils, œuvres d’Adrien Lucca et de Laure Winants, interrogent la manière dont l’activité humaine et le changement climatique transforment, lentement et presque imperceptiblement, nos écosystèmes : des effets de la pollution lumineuse urbaine sur les pollinisateurs nocturnes aux dynamiques invisibles qui façonnent le climat en mer du Nord. Par le jeu subtil de la lumière et de la couleur, ils métamorphosent les collections et les recherches scientifiques de l’Institut en une expérience immersive, sensible et concrète. Ce dialogue ne s’arrête pas aux murs du musée, mais se prolonge sur le toit de l’Institut. La sculpture de deux personnages de Senne Dehandschutter s’élève depuis une hauteur vertigineuse vers la ville, à la recherche de lumière et d’espace. Ces Lichtzoekers (Chercheurs de lumière) nous invitent à élargir notre regard et à imaginer ce qui se trouve au-delà de l’horizon urbain. Un duo grandeur nature faisant écho à l’exposition temporaire Flight. Des galeries au toit de l’Institut, nous vous invitons chaleureusement à venir découvrir et expérimenter ces nouvelles propositions artistiques.

title.en: Podwalk - In the footsteps of the Burgundians, with Bart Van Loo through Brussels
title.fr: Podwalk - Sur les traces des Téméraires, avec Bart Van Loo à travers le Bruxelles bourguignon
title.nl: Podwalk - Stoute Schoenen – Een Bourgondische wandeling in Brussel

ai.en: Embark on a historical audio walk through Brussels with storyteller Bart Van Loo, tracing the legacy of the Burgundians. Visit the KBR museum to see illuminated manuscripts from the era.
ai.fr: Embarquez pour une promenade historique audio à travers Bruxelles avec le conteur Bart Van Loo, retraçant l'héritage des Bourguignons. Visitez le musée KBR pour découvrir des manuscrits enluminés de l'époque.
ai.nl: Ga op een historische audiotour door Brussel met verteller Bart Van Loo, die de erfenis van de Bourgondiërs volgt. Bezoek het KBR museum om verlichte manuscripten uit die tijd te bekijken.

events.description: With the podwalk “In the footsteps of the Burgundians, with Bart Van Loo through Brussels” storyteller Bart Van Loo takes you on a historical walk through the heart of the capital. Starting at Place des Palais, discover emblematic locations where the legacy of the Burgundian era can still be felt today. Throughout the walk, Bart Van Loo immerses you in a captivating story of political power, court intrigues and banquets, religion, art, and daily life in Burgundian Brussels. In the footsteps of Philip the Good, Charles the Bold, and Emperor Charles V, a story unfolds of ambition, splendour, and intrigue. A podwalk means listening while you walk. Thanks to GPS localisation, the audio segments are triggered automatically at the right moment during your route. Continue your journey through time at the KBR museum, located within the Royal Library of Belgium, home to the magnificent collection of illuminated manuscripts from the Dukes of Burgundy. As guest curator, Bart Van Loo has selected some of the most evocative manuscripts from KBR’s rich collections, bringing you even closer to the Burgundian court of the 15th and 16th centuries. Miniatures of extraordinary beauty bring the stories heard in the city to life, embodying history in parchment and pigment.

summary.en: Through previously unseen pieces, recently acquired or specially retrieved from storage, you will plunge into the extraordinary history of Brussels lace. A fabric that has since disappeared.
summary.fr: Avec des pièces inédites, acquises récemment ou sorties spécialement des réserves, plongez dans l’histoire exceptionnelle de la dentelle de Bruxelles. Une étoffe aujourd’hui disparue.
summary.nl: Dankzij nooit eerder vertoonde stukken, recent verworven of speciaal uit de opslagruimtes gehaald, duikt u in de uitzonderlijke geschiedenis van het Brusselse kantwerk. Een weefsel dat inmiddels verdwenen is.

ai.en: Explore the history and artistry of lace, particularly Brussels lace, at the Fashion & Lace Museum. Discover how this delicate textile evolved from elite adornment to widespread fashion.
ai.fr: Explorez l'histoire et l'art de la dentelle, en particulier la dentelle de Bruxelles, au Musée du Costume et de la Dentelle. Découvrez comment ce textile délicat est passé d'ornement d'élite à mode répandue.
ai.nl: Ontdek de geschiedenis en kunst van kant, met name Brussels kant, in het Mode & Kant Museum. Leer hoe deze delicate textiel evolueerde van een statussymbool voor de elite tot wijdverspreide mode.

events.description: Lace is an openwork fabric made with a needle or bobbins. The motifs are connected to each other by a background of stripes or mesh. Initially, it was made by hand and later it was mechanised. Lace is distinguished by its techniques, materials, motifs, colours, etc. Brussels lace has gained international renown over the centuries. Its finesse, quality and beauty made it the preferred textile of the elites from the 17th century. It found its way to the greatest royal courts of Europe, adorning the apparel of both men and women. In the 19th century, lace became more democratic and widespread thanks to mechanisation. The price of fabric fell. Lace then conquered women's fashion. Remarkable pieces were made in unprecedented large sizes, lace became a garment. This mechanisation marked the end of handmade lace. Brussels lace disappears with the First World War. Access to the Studio is included in the price of admission to the museum.

events.description: Seven stops, two hours, walked and explained by Karel. History and culture are his subject, and this is the walk he'd give a friend arriving in Brussels for the first time. You start on the steps of the opera house, where an audience once walked out of a performance and into a revolution. From there the walk climbs. The lanes are narrow at first, the kind the guilds built to make money in rather than to be admired, and then the street opens, the sky comes in, and you're on the hill where a brand-new country built itself somewhere respectable to be seen. But you'll do more than have landmarks pointed out to you. Brussels is the eternal building site, and there's a reason nobody explains it: a town of merchants was handed a country in 1830 and has been proving itself capital-worthy ever since. Cutting boulevards, burying a river, raising monuments to an identity nobody had needed before. You can read the whole argument in the street plan, two cities meeting along a seam you can cross in a minute, once someone has shown you where it runs. You finish under the Congress Column, above the rooftops and off most itineraries, where the constitution and the imported king who signed it are written into the stone. Brussels lies below you, and the whole two hours is visible in one view.

events.description: Eight Belgian beers, ten centilitres of each, poured and explained by Karel. He trained as a brewer at COOVI Anderlecht, worked in two Belgian breweries, and once made and bottled his own beer. This two-hour private tasting takes you through Belgian brewing in eight beers, from the wild fermentation of the Zenne valley to the breweries working in its shadow today. But you'll do more than drink good beer. You'll find out how a small country ended up with the most renowned brewing tradition in the world, and how much of that tradition was invented: abbey brands built by marketing departments in the 1950s, farmhouse beers rescued from near-extinction by foreigners, and one genuinely ancient style that Belgians themselves abandoned. It is as improvised as Belgium itself, assembled from monastic economics, farm wages and a postwar industry that needed something pilsner couldn't offer. You already know the famous names, but you probably don't know which are traditions and which are branding. By the end, you'll understand what's in your glass, not just enjoy it. You sit with Karel around one table in the Salle d'étoile, a room inside the Maison de la Francité on rue Joseph II, a house remodelled in 1895 by Léon Govaerts and decorated by Henri Privat-Livemont, the great Belgian Art Nouveau poster artist. The interior is listed and closed to the public. Most people in Brussels have walked past it their whole lives without ever tasting a Belgian beer inside it.

events.description: Welcome to The Artist, an immersive creative space where art becomes an experience to live rather than simply observe. Located in Brussels, The Artist offers original artistic experiences designed to unleash creativity in a dynamic, fun and accessible environment. No artistic skills are required: here, what matters is not the result, but the emotions, the joy of creating and the memories shared along the way. Discover Action Painting, a collaborative experience inspired by gestural painting, where participants create one or more large-scale artworks through creative challenges, games and interactions that encourage communication, teamwork and self-expression. Explore Drip Painting, a spectacular experience where colours are poured, splashed and blended to create unique, vibrant and fully personalised artworks. All materials are provided, including paints, protective equipment and guidance. Each participant leaves with their own creation or contributes to a memorable collective artwork. The Artist welcomes individuals, families, groups of friends, couples, birthday celebrations, bachelor and bachelorette parties, as well as companies looking for an original and engaging team-building experience. Come create, experiment and share an unforgettable moment at The Artist, an immersive artistic experience in the heart of Brussels.

events.description: L’exposition « Lactissimo » vous invite à un voyage unique à la découverte du lait dans tous ses états. Que se cache-t-il derrière ce produit courant de notre quotidien ? Depuis quand l’être humain consomme-t-il du lait ? D’où vient-il et où va-t-il ? À quel point est-il ancré dans notre culture ? Quel est son impact sur notre santé ? Qui pense au lait pense aussi à ses dérivés. Comment parvient-on par exemple à le transformer en beurre ou en fromage ? Enfin, la face sombre du lait et de l’industrie laitière ne sera pas oubliée. Quelles sont les problématiques actuelles et quelles alternatives peut-on trouver sur le marché ?

events.description: De wandeling ‘Joodse vrouwen in de Marollen, van 1900 tot 1945’ brengt de Joodse geschiedenis van de wijk tot leven aan de hand van de verhalen van elf vrouwen. Hun levensverhalen schetsen een beeld van het Joodse leven in de Marollen, van het einde van de negentiende eeuw tot na de Tweede Wereldoorlog. Ze vertellen over migratie, integratie en vervolging, maar ook over de groeiende zelfstandigheid en vrijheidsdrang van vrouwen. We ontdekken hoe vrouwen hun eigen weg zochten, welke rol ze speelden in het verzet en hoe ze, vaak met gevaar voor eigen leven, hun eigen kinderen en die van anderen beschermden. Samen belichten deze verhalen de moed, veerkracht en solidariteit van vrouwen in tijden van verandering en onderdrukking.
